title: Replicating Emergent Misalignment on a Small Open Model with LoRA

original_idea.body: # Replicating Emergent Misalignment on a Small Open Model with LoRA. LoRA fine-tune a 1.5-3B model on insecure code, evaluate broad misalignment before/after, vary the protective benign-motivation framing.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Establishing small-model emergent misalignment yields an accessible model organism for a recognized critical failure mode.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: LoRA fine-tune of 1.5-3B model with published dataset + LLM-judge; guided, single GPU.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused replication + one-factor variation; fine-tuning + judging is a real workstream.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open model organism for community study; labs deprioritize accessible-scale replication.

low_compute.reasoning: LoRA fine-tuning of a small model on a single GPU, a few GPU-hours.

novelty.reasoning: Emergent misalignment already replicated on small models (Model Organisms paper, Qwen); largely addressed.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Small-model emergent misalignment already demonstrated in follow-up work.
